name: button
title: Button
description: The action button. Labels wrap to two lines rather than overflowing, so long translated text stays inside the pill.
docs: Use the default size (44px) for every action button in an app; it matches size="icon" and the shared control height Input, Select, SearchField, option tiles and SidebarTabs all take, so a row of mixed controls lines up. Reserve size="lg" for hero and landing CTAs, and size="sm" (36px) for dense chrome such as a card-hover action. The accent variant is the primary action and secondary the bordered one; selection is the surface that reads as selectable rather than actionable, and takes its chosen state from aria-pressed.
